Players Committee card image of [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber (V) (Playtest)]] — a '''Playtest''' image: published on 12 July 2019, before Virtual Set 11's official release (2 August 2019), and replaced before release. Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/426f8e6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/darkjedilightsaber.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/darkjedilightsaber.gif] as of commit 426f8e6 “Jedi Lightsabers” (12 July 2019).
